join hortbot 2 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "This is a test." added as quote #1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote editor 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1 was last edited by foobar.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 access=admin :!quote edit 1 "This is a testerino."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1 edited.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote editor 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1 was last edited by random.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote editor 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #0 does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote editor -1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #-1 does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote editor 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #2 does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote editor
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote editor <index>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote editor asd
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote editor <index>


handle hortbot foobar/1 random2/4 :!quote editor 1
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random2/4 access=subscriber :!quote editor 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1 was last edited by random.
